summary: Hood River County, OR tower: a 20-foot pole L-5 tower built by the USFS in 1933, never manned, gone by 1949; no source describes the site today.

notes_for_editor: Core facts agree across the Register and Firelookout.com: the 1933 USFS pole tower, never manned or used, gone by 1949. The record has no access or visit facts, and no source read describes the site today or whether the summit is open, so those keys are left out. The Register page credits a 2012 photo of the site (courtesy Howard Verschoor); its image URL was not available, so it is not added. The story is short because the sources are thin.
